name: classes-explicit
description: The restarted class grid (borg-zoo#54): the mode cutoff's two faces on one specimen - better-borg-c at 9ca98661 under munchkin-class (Warriors, Druids and Rangers stair-scum at depth 6, the product default) against normal (every mode pinned off) - for every class and race (classes-1800). Replaces classes-m9-m10's cross-boundary comparison, which paired a pre-rule original against post-rule milestones under one profile name and measured the mode drift instead of the milestones.
